verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://milvus.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Milvus summary header), so an agent can be pointed directly at it. The docs are also published as raw markdown in the milvus-docs GitHub repo, which agents can ingest easily. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or linked doc index), first-party documentation promoting agent-oriented docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use it effectively.
